## Profile

Biostatistics leader pairing hands-on industry development and FDA regulatory
experience across the drug-development lifecycle with a strong academic and
methodological foundation. Currently Senior Manager, Biostatistics at Pfizer
(Associate Director–equivalent) and a member of the Data Science & Analytics
India leadership team, leading a team of statisticians across global Oncology and
Inflammation & Immunology programs. Former FDA Oncology Center of Excellence
primary reviewer with hands-on NDA/BLA experience, product-labelling negotiation,
and pioneering use of real-world evidence and external-control cohorts.

## Research focus

Much of my recent work sits in two places: using **target trial emulation** to
bring observational data to bear on questions trials answer slowly or not at all,
and **endpoint and estimand strategy** — deciding what a trial should measure
before arguing about how to analyse it.
